caption: The drawing depicts a woman wearing a long, flowing dress with a fitted bodice and full skirt. The dress is predominantly light purple with a delicate floral pattern in white spread across the entire fabric, including the bodice and skirt. The bodice features a high, ruffled lace collar and vertical lace trim running down the front, as well as lace at the cuffs of the long, loose sleeves that gather at the wrists and flare at the ends. The woman has light skin, brown hair styled in waves and tied back, and she stands with her arms slightly extended. In the top right corner of the image, there is a rectangular swatch showing a close-up of the dress fabric pattern with small white flowers and branches against a light purple background. The drawing is outlined in black ink and filled in with washes of pale purple, pink, and beige, while the background is plain and off-white. The artist’s signature, "Lillian Causey," is located at the bottom right.
title: Dress
